Superficie eficiente (50 m²): Distribución idónea que aprovecha al máximo el espacio de atención al público, elaboración y almacenamiento.

� Ideal Para:

Negocios consolidados que buscan abrir un nuevo punto de venta directo al cliente en Málaga.

inv.desc_en:
Turnkey Opportunity! On Calle Trafalgar (Málaga)

Are you looking to launch your own project in Málaga immediately and without surprises?

We offer you this impeccable 50 m² commercial space, perfectly prepared and adapted, which has a license for the sale of artisanal cakes.

Located on Calle Trafalgar, a strategic area of Málaga with excellent foot traffic, surrounded by shops, services, and a well-established residential environment.

Key Features of the Premises
Up-to-date license: It has a license for the sale of artisanal cakes, allowing you to start operations from day one without long administrative waits.

Condition of the premises: In excellent condition, ready to start working.

Machinery and facilities: Includes machinery in perfect working order, ready for business operations.

Efficient surface area (50 m²): Ideal layout that makes the most of the space for customer service, preparation, and storage.

Ideal For:
Entrepreneurs and master pastry chefs who want to launch their own brand of cakes and artisanal pastries.
Established businesses looking to open a new direct-to-customer point of sale in Málaga.
Investors looking for a commercial asset ready to generate profit without the need for renovations.

Interested in seeing it?
Don't miss this opportunity to establish your business in a privileged location in Málaga, with the premises and its equipment in impeccable condition.

Location: Calle Trafalgar, Málaga
Surface area: 50 m²
License: Sale of artisanal cakes
Contact: Schedule your private visit today and come see it without obligation.

Request information and schedule a visit.

At Traspasos Málaga, we accompany you throughout the entire process of purchase, negotiation, contract review, and change of ownership for licenses and utilities, so that the transaction is carried out with total security and transparency.

Buyer's fees: one month's rent (+ VAT), payable only at the time of signing the transaction.
